meta.name: list-builder
meta.description: Guides users to build a targeted prospect list in lemlist by translating an ICP into concrete search filters and signal configurations. Use when asked "build me a list", "find me leads", "find me prospects", "how do I find companies to target", "help me build a prospect list", "where do I start to find leads", or any request to identify or compile a list of potential customers. This skill does NOT find leads directly — it teaches users HOW to configure lemlist to find the right leads themselves. Always use before people-finder or company-finder.

copy.tagline: 教会你配置lemlist筛选理想客户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用lemlist找潜在客户但不知如何设置筛选条件。
copy.tagline_en: Teach you to configure lemlist filters for ideal prospects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use lemlist to find leads but need help setting up search filters.

howto.what: 指导你把目标客户画像（ICP）转化为lemlist中的具体搜索过滤器和信号配置，教会你如何自己找到理想客户，而不是直接给你线索。
howto.when: 当你提出“帮我建个列表”、“找线索”、“找潜在客户”或类似请求时触发。

say.text: 我想找做SaaS的潜在客户，该怎么做？
帮我建一个针对营销主管的列表。
say.note: Claude会询问产品、客户特征等来制定搜索策略。

howto.what_en: Guides you to turn your ideal customer profile (ICP) into concrete search filters and signal configurations in lemlist, teaching you how to find your own prospects instead of giving you leads directly.
howto.when_en: When you say "build me a list", "find leads", "find prospects", or any similar request to identify potential customers.

say_en.text: I want to find potential customers for my SaaS product. How do I do that?
say_en.note: Claude will help define ICP and configure lemlist.

say_en.text: Help me build a list of marketing leads.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about your product and target persona.
